moments.action: A young American stares out over the street from the dark, neon washed night; the angle drops back to show him at a high railing with a second man beside him, who tips a drink back as they look down.
Aerials sweep over Tokyo at night, from a lit rooftop football pitch and a crowded crossing out to the whole glittering sprawl, then cut down to a blue road sign pointing on to Gaien and Shibuya.
Two cars cruise an empty neon boulevard. From the back seat of the purple Skyline the two women watch the road, while the orange RX-7 draws level; by the end both women have turned to size it up.
The orange RX-7 swings in tight beside the Skyline and both cars break into a slide; the women lean to the open window laughing as the camera whips past, the cruise turning into a show.
The RX-7 piles on smoke and an overhead shot shows the two cars carving a ring around each other; the women grin through the windscreen while their driver holds the wheel hard over.
The pair orbit each other inside a thickening cloud of tyre smoke, swapping inside and outside lines, until the donut unwinds and both cars settle facing one another in the scorched circle.
Through the RX-7 window the two men look across at the women, who smile back; the driver's grin widens and the woman in the other car dabs her flushed face with a napkin, laughing.

The two cars sit level under their headlights; inside the RX-7 the American and the driver trade a look and both break into grins, then the view lifts to an aerial of the cars crossing the night street.

Daylight on a mountain road: the long-haired driver stands by a red hatchback with a green van and spectators behind him, a POV runs the empty curve, then he turns back toward the car and the watching group.
